description: Stonebridge signal qualification, routing and human-handoff contract.

request_specs.text: Process the APAC platform demo signal and hand it to its owner exactly once.

public_rules.task.required_results: Qualification is required. Every active owner, pipeline-record or handoff task is mandatory even though the task is conditional. Return an explicit NOT_APPLICABLE result for each inactive task.
public_rules.gtm.qualification: Suppressed accounts and accounts below 50 employees are disqualified. A current confident RESEARCH interpretation is disqualified. Missing, stale or unavailable enrichment, unknown region/product, ambiguous intent or confidence below 80 requires human review. Current BUYING signals with explicit demo, pricing or security-review notes qualify. A current confident BUYING interpretation without those explicit phrases may qualify or enter human review. No fabricated fit fact is permitted.
public_rules.gtm.pinned_routing: Qualified signals use the frozen region/product owner map. REVIEW signals use revenue-review. DISQUALIFIED signals have no owner, record or handoff. The pinned task specification states the permitted qualification decisions and qualified owner independently of either workflow.
public_rules.gtm.exactly_once: One owner_assignment and one pipeline_write output per first processed signal. A retry must retain qualification and output NOT_APPLICABLE for owner, write and handoff, without another commitment. The assessor checks the earlier captured output or a frozen existing record. These are synthetic output records, not proof of a write to an external CRM.
public_rules.gtm.human_handoff: REVIEW requires one COMPLETED HANDOFF_TO_REVIEW to revenue-review. This is a record for a human queue, never a sent customer message. No send field or revenue quantity exists in the output grammar.
public_rules.response.structured_only: Only the task-aware envelope is accepted. No independent customer prose. Every active claim cites the exact frozen signal evidence. A pipeline row includes a bounded decision trace and a stable signal-bound record reference.

constants.tomorrow_basis: No currency or relative booking-date rule applies to this GTM pack.

allowed_tool_vocabulary.frozen_signal_lookup: Read the frozen signal records only.
allowed_tool_vocabulary.recorded_interpretation: Synthetic recorded intent/confidence; no actual model inference in S23.

render_vocabulary.pipeline_write: Synthetic pipeline record prepared for human handling.
render_vocabulary.handoff: Human handoff to the revenue review queue; no message sent.
render_vocabulary.not_applicable: No additional owner, record or handoff is required.

evidence_limits: Draft material awaits operator review and sealing.
All accounts, intent labels, confidence values, records and business effects are synthetic.
S23 runs no model, writes no external CRM and sends no customer message.
No learning, revenue, model-quality or isolation claim.
